sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (the light from above)
line tracker, brightness of the floor in %

control_flow: followInTheDark: if the light is below 70 % (dark), follow the line by the floor's brightness (below 90 %: curve left; above 90 %: curve right; neither: avoidWalls); if it is bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if it is dark, turn away from a wall on the left or right, otherwise drive on; if it is bright, drive on.
driveInTheDark: if it is dark, drive forward at 30 %; if it is bright, call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Keep following the black line when it gets dark, and follow it in the light as before.
